name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF wet-bulb-zero Snowline proxy to +144 h with adaptive contours, terrain-aware point labels, precipitation cues, and a draggable Snowline time graph. Version 3.2 adds interactive graph readouts, a clickable Crossing terrain marker that jumps Windy to that forecast time, and a compact summary of lowest snowline, peak precipitation and terrain crossing. Includes Windy native detail forecast, search, favourites, My location, share/copy, help and caching.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
